title: LTA — National Tennis Centre Roehampton
scope: Official LTA description of the National Tennis Centre opened in 2007 and its courts, sport-science and multidisciplinary high-performance services.
limitations: Facility and service capacity does not guarantee realised player outcomes and cannot be backcast before 2007. Earth code GBR is the United Kingdom, while LTA/Great Britain tennis remit is not a perfect political-territory match (notably Northern Ireland, and LTA inclusion of Channel Islands/Isle of Man); this source is therefore an explicit association-remit proxy rather than a literal UK census.
